nodes.label: Enriched Revision-Validated Directory Projection
nodes.rationale: One request replaces a per-callback RPC storm: current/parent metadata, every child with metadata, complete xattr names, and bounded small xattr values. The adapter single-flights cold loads, creates stable local inodes, and answers the resulting lookup/getattr/listxattr/negative-xattr burst locally; directory and embedded-child metadata share one 30-second lifetime so children cannot expire mid-wave.

nodes.label: Directory Opens Without FOPEN_CACHE_DIR
nodes.rationale: The adapter's coherent snapshot already covers Finder's follow-up callbacks, while an extra kernel directory pin could hide a completed mutation. Synchronous fuser invalidation notifications are also never issued from inside a callback because the single macOS receive loop can block on them.

nodes.label: Lossless Unix Byte Names
nodes.rationale: macOS lookup tries exact bytes first, then NFD/case-insensitive folding only when both names are valid UTF-8; ambiguous folded names fail rather than selecting the wrong file. macOS rejects invalid UTF-8 pathnames before they reach the adapter, so only Linux and the wire format preserve them.

nodes.label: Export-Root Confinement
nodes.rationale: Absolute symlink targets and targets containing .. are rejected to preserve confinement. Xattrs on the symlink object itself are rejected because portable descriptor-relative Unix APIs cannot address them without a path race.

nodes.label: Capability-Gated Optional Callbacks
nodes.rationale: copy_file_range, readdirplus, and exchangedata are implemented but gated because the macFUSE 5.3 kernel backend on macOS 15.1 advertises none of them; macFUSE dropped exchangedata on macOS 11 and FSKit requires macOS 15.4+. The protocol/client/server operations remain usable and transport-tested for a future bridge that advertises them.

nodes.label: Epoch-Matched Authenticated Reconnect
nodes.rationale: Reconnect accepts only the same persisted server epoch. Revision-matched handles are reopened and live-client lock state replayed after a daemon restart; locks are not immortal disk state, so closing or disconnecting the owner releases them.

nodes.label: Best-Effort Unmount With Watchdog
nodes.rationale: Unmount performs no synchronous network cleanup so it never depends on a live server: handle closes are best-effort under a short bound, Control+C falls back to a forced local macFUSE detach after three seconds, and a process-level eight-second watchdog bounds even a wedged OS unmount call.
